name: Frankenburg Technologies
talks: Bloomberg reported Frankenburg is seeking a fresh EUR 100M Series B (about USD 116M) that could make it a unicorn; Resilience Media confirmed details with a company source.

name: Endurance Energy
talks: Axios Pro reported, citing two sources, that Endurance Energy is raising about USD 150M in Series B funding for subsea offshore geothermal.

name: DG Matrix
talks: Axios Pro headline reported DG Matrix is raising USD 250M for solid-state transformers (body text not seen).

name: XGS Energy
talks: Axios Pro scoop: XGS Energy is preparing to raise USD 300M in private funding, planning to begin the raise in September.

name: Gauss Fusion
talks: Axios Pro reported German fusion start-up Gauss Fusion is pitching US investors on a USD 150M Series A round.

name: Irregular
talks: Calcalist (CTech) reported Irregular is raising more than USD 100M at a USD 1.5B valuation, led by Thrive Capital and Greenoaks; financing not yet finalised.

name: GSR
talks: Bloomberg reported Standard Chartered's SC Ventures backed GSR at a valuation above USD 1B (first outside shareholder); follow-ups say GSR is raising up to USD 150M from further strategic investors, final size and valuation may change.

name: Aroma-Zone
talks: Eurazeo entered exclusive talks to sell its stake to Partners Group, which would take a majority; press reports valued Aroma-Zone at about EUR 2B including debt.

name: OpenAI
talks: Reportedly in talks to raise USD 30B at USD 1.4T; later reported to have raised USD 11B at USD 1.25T with up to ~USD 20B expected.

name: Anduril Industries
talks: Reuters reported talks for a round valuing Anduril at about USD 100B; amount not determined.

name: Kalshi
talks: In talks to raise new funds at a USD 65B valuation, weeks after a USD 1B round at USD 40B; size not disclosed.

name: Anysphere (Cursor)
talks: In talks to raise USD 2B at a valuation above USD 50B, CNBC reported (Apr 2026, before the 1 May window).

name: Switch
talks: In talks to raise billions at a valuation of at least USD 50B, Brookfield and KKR in talks to join, The Information reported.

name: Thinking Machines Lab
talks: In talks to raise at least USD 1B at a USD 40B-plus pre-money valuation led by Accel, per The Information (Axios Pro Rata).

name: Etched
talks: Fielding funding offers at USD 40B-plus valuation, sources told TechCrunch; talks early.

name: Isomorphic Labs
talks: Bloomberg reported Isomorphic Labs is in early talks to raise new funds at a valuation of at least USD 40B, possibly up to USD 50B; the financing has not closed and details could change.

name: Applied Intuition
talks: In talks to raise USD 1.5B at a USD 30B valuation, Bloomberg reported.

name: Colossal Biosciences
talks: In talks to raise new capital at a USD 20-30B valuation.

name: Devoted Health
talks: In talks for a new round at a USD 25B valuation, up from USD 16B, Business Insider reported.

name: Devoted Health
talks: Raising a new round at a USD 25B valuation, up from USD 16B.

name: Physical Intelligence
talks: In talks to raise at least USD 1B at about USD 20B, Avenir and Lux in talks to lead, Bloomberg reported.

name: Zipline
talks: Bloomberg reported Zipline in talks on about USD 1B raise at about USD 20B valuation, Paradigm in discussions to lead.

name: Cyera
talks: In advanced talks to raise about USD 800M at about USD 20B valuation, with Cyberstarts putting in about USD 300M.

name: Polymarket
talks: In talks for a new round at a valuation north of USD 20B; size not disclosed.

name: Helsing
talks: FT (via TechCrunch) and Handelsblatt reported Helsing negotiating a USD 1.2B raise at about USD 18B valuation.

name: Modal Labs
talks: Closing in on a USD 750M round led by Accel at USD 15.75B, a source told TechCrunch.

name: Harvey
talks: In talks to raise at least USD 500M at a USD 15.5B valuation including new money, The Information reported.
